evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Entering name/optional description are attributes of the single feature 'create game', not separate independently prioritizable features.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a round with an entered item; the multi-line field is an attribute of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the session’s items list; the example question is just motivation.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item (whether first-time or re-estimate) is one feature: choosing the active item for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item to the estimation list.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing an item.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: revealing estimates before all have voted.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting the computed average as the estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: auto-fill estimate under a specific condition.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: manually entering the final agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: importing stories from a spreadsheet.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding stories via copy/paste from a spreadsheet.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing previous games (finding is the purpose).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing a game transcript.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript in HTML format.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: exporting transcript in CSV format.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting a game; the rest is consequence.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation; the multiple fields are attributes of that one feature.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: logging in.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: “Account details” bundles multiple independently changeable features (e.g., change email, change password, change username) into one story.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting the user account (data deletion is outcome).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying dates/times in local timezone.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {…} or {…}
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: choosing between two card/scale sets; the two options are alternatives within one configuration feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: enforcing/supporting an invitation limit of 15.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: joining a game with a name entry.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying the current item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the list of items for the session.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: showing per-estimator submission status (not the estimate value).

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: simultaneous reveal of estimates after all votes are in.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes until the reveal condition is met.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying prior estimates per estimator for the current story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: showing mapping of estimator to estimate for the round.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a shared visible two-minute timer.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic timer reset triggered by all estimates being played.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: reviewing prior rounds’ stories/estimates (scrolling/back navigation).

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: consistent card ordering across draws.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: allowing estimate changes until draw completion.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: displaying a participant thumbnail near their played cards.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently checkable compliance targets (XHTML compliance and CSS compliance) rather than a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing a glossary/list of definitions.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding database indexes (even if multiple indexes, they serve one cohesive performance feature).

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Bundles multiple independently testable compatibility targets (different browsers/versions) into one story; each could be prioritized/tested separately.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature/goal: accessibility compliance (guidelines are part of one compliance target).

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Single quality requirement: responsiveness/performance.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Single feature/goal: predictable URL scheme.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: user-friendly error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Single feature/requirement: non-identifiable storage of results; the example analysis use is motivation.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: "Some metrics" implies multiple distinct metrics/features (e.g., counts, trends, retention) that are independently implementable and prioritizable, making the story non-atomic.
